definiteFindings.fact: When a dirty form source is removed/changed, the default resolver persistently refuses save. Close leaves allowsDismiss false and dirty true; the visible failure alert only acknowledges, while native swipe is refused and retries the same failing Close. There is no explicit discard-and-close path.
definiteFindings.scope: A normal visible SOURCE_CHANGED/save-error path. Forced OS destruction logging does not provide a user-visible exit.
definiteFindings.status: Reported to root and author; root decides the bounded native alert policy. No extra owner, source mutation registry or credential cache requested.
